what: LONG-TAIL BATCH F, STEP 1 — Battle#boost refuses when the boosted body's foe side has no Pokemon left, so an after-loop `selfBoost` paid on the wiping KO must stop being paid.
written: 2026-09-06, BEFORE the measuring run, by ENGINE.

baseline.note: The live tree was normalised to LF and `engine_release.js drift 14b62cd5aeec` reads NO-DRIFT, so the baseline is byte-reproducible and was NOT re-run.

the_rule: sim/battle.ts:2028 — `if (this.gen > 5 && !target.side.foePokemonLeft()) return false;`. `pokemonLeft` is decremented inside faintMessages (sim/battle.ts:2550) regardless of its checkWin argument, and the after-loop selfBoost payment (sim/battle-actions.ts:520) sits BELOW that decrement while `selfDrops` (scripts.ts:385) sits above it. So the guard belongs at exactly one site.
probe: tests/probe_selfboost_empty_foe_side.js, knob MEDI_SELFBOOST_IGNORES_EMPTY_FOE_SIDE. Shown RED first: every fixture and authority assertion green, and exactly the two engine assertions red — `medicham2 refuses it too` reads 1 drop against the authority's 0, and the wiping game parts on `|-unboost|p1a: Kommo-o|def|1` where the authority emitted nothing further.
which_scoreboard: THE POOL, not the lab. Clanging Scales is a real ladder click and all three rows are pinned-pool games. The census/roster are expected to sit still: no tag changes, no new mechanic, and the roster stages no side wipe.
why_three: The by-cause table on 14b62cd5aeec carries THREE board-parted rows that are all this one click: `|-damage|p2b|H/H|[from]lifeorb <> |-unboost|p2b|def|1` (SHARED-COIN), `|-damage|p1b|H/H|[from]lifeorb <> |-unboost|p1b|def|1` (instrument-suspect, same shape), and `showdown stopped emitting while medicham2 continued :: |-unboost|p2b|def|1` (instrument-suspect). Each is one game.
why_it_might_miss_HIGH: The batch-D and batch-E mechanism: a game whose named cause closes plays on and re-parts on a DIFFERENT cause the `-unboost` was standing in front of. Two of the three end the battle at that exact line, so there is little game left to re-part on — but the Life Orb pair each continue for at least one more line.
why_it_might_miss_LOW: If a game outside the three carries an after-loop selfBoost on a wiping KO whose first divergence is attributed elsewhere, the count could fall further than 38. Only Clanging Scales and Scale Shot carry `selfBoost` in this format, and Scale Shot is 90-accuracy multihit, so the population is small either way.
narration_note: Closing a board divergence often MOVES the game into the narration column rather than removing it. narration_only is deliberately left null: it is not this step's target and predicting it would be a guess.
